brief: Fit the full library cascade (powder dosing, synthesis platform, evaporator, LC-MS, acoustic dispenser, reagent dispenser, plate reader and a robot arm) into our 3 x 2.5 m room.
expected_behaviour: Say it does not fit: a fume hood or synthesis enclosure alone is ~1.8-2.5 m wide, and egress needs ~1.2 m clear width. Show the layout violations instead of hiding them, and suggest which part (synthesis or screening) to move to a second room.
